A '''hydro-thinner''' was a device used by crews on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] where sub-zero temperatures were common, such as [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was used to remove ice from [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other equipment.

==Behind the scenes==
The hydro-thinner first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is purchasable from Cantina Vendors on Hoth and used to access one of the [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]] on the planet, which is encased in a block of ice.
